closing.summary: Big strengths are fibre, protein, and magnesium, but the biggest weaknesses are low vitamin E, low omega 3, and easy to overdo in real portions. It is good for bone health, heart health, and digestion because calcium and magnesium gives the bone-health case something to work with, fibre supports the heart-health side, and fibre supports digestion and steadier meals.
